newsitem.title: PERU: Spain's BBV loans Telefonica del Peru $200 million.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BBV loans Telefonica del Peru $200 million.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya de Espana has loaned Telefonica del Peru $200 million for the telecom's investment plans to improve equipment, company officials said Wednesday.

The loan will be divided into two parts, with $150 million maturing within 10 years, and $50 million maturing within 18 months, Banco Continental, which is majority-owned by Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, said in a statement.
The statement gave no details on the interest rate charged for the loan.
Telefonica del Peru, the benchmark issue of the Lima Stock Exchange, is controlled by Telefonica de Espana.
